objective: Compose a complete deterministic insurance created-at relationship cohort from bounded keyset pages before any downstream evidence loading.

semantics.ordering: preserve bounded page order and first occurrence across pages
semantics.pageSize: internal persistence page size only; default 100; valid range 1 through 100
semantics.completion: continue until the page reader returns hasMore false
semantics.deduplication: relationship identity is deduplicated defensively while preserving first occurrence

continuationSafety: hasMore false must not expose nextCursor
a continuation cursor must equal the final relationship returned by the current page
a continuation cursor must advance and must never repeat
hasMore true requires a non-empty page
rules: The compositor depends only on a structural bounded page-reader contract.
The compositor does not depend on D1Database.
The compositor performs no economics, outcome, presentation, or raw-evidence reads.
The compositor never performs an unbounded relationship read.
Canonical UTC range boundaries are validated before reader access.
Page size is validated before reader access.
Every returned relationship identity and createdAt timestamp is validated.
Every returned relationship must fall inside the requested created-at range.
Public reporting limit semantics are not changed in this slice.
No existing reporting consumer is migrated in this slice.
No schema migration is added or executed in this slice.
explicitlyDeferred: public report limit versus completeness semantics
explicit partial-cohort metadata on bounded reports
created_at plus relationship_id compound database index
